content:
If you are not using the console UI to manage your process definitions and process instances, you can use the client helper application which exposes an API with a Swagger page to do some basic operations. 

The application can be found in the examples repo and specifically in the client-swagger-ui subfolder. By cloning the repo you can start the application with the following command:

 ./gradlew -p client-swagger-ui quarkusDev

By default the application is configured to connect to the kafka running at localhost:9092

When the application has started you can open the Swagger-ui at

http://localhost:8082/q/swagger-ui/

This will show a Swagger UI which allows you to retrieve the deployed process definitions and start (batches of) process instances and pass a set of variables with it. Note that there is a difference in just starting a set of process instances and starting a job. The first will start the given number of process instances immediately. The latter one will start the given number of process instances every second. Jobs can also be changed and stopped by using the corresponding endpoints.
